purpose: Extract one or more API-specific, evidence-grounded Bug Pattern candidates from exactly one structured Bug Report.

input_assumptions.evidence_rule: Every evidence_refs value in the response must be selected from available_evidence_refs supplied with the input report.

response_requirements.maximum_pattern_count_rule: Create multiple patterns only when the report contains independently testable trigger-mechanism-failure combinations or independent API scopes.

semantic_rules: Each emitted Pattern must contain exactly one supporting Report: the input Report, with relation direct_evidence.
Do not emit corroborating_evidence during single-Report extraction.
Do not invent Report IDs, APIs, operators, modules, Issue facts, fix facts, reproduction facts, evidence references, or root causes.
confirmed_apis must contain only APIs explicitly supported by the input Report.
A historical oracle records only an observation from historical evidence. Do not propose a new testing oracle.
Do not include harness code, mutation procedures, tensor-construction procedures, Strategy Primitives, HarnessSpec content, prompt text, or unbounded testing advice.
If the root cause is unavailable, return an empty defect_mechanism.hypotheses array rather than inventing an explanation.
A claim marked official_confirmed, patch_derived, or source_reported must include at least one evidence reference.
An analyst_inferred claim may be emitted only when its supporting evidence is cited and its confidence is medium or low.

value_selection_rules.unknown_enum_value: Use unknown only when the field is a controlled enum and the input Report provides no reliable value.
value_selection_rules.unknown_free_text_value: Use null when a free-text or ordinary scalar value is unavailable.
value_selection_rules.unknown_list_value: Use an empty array when no supported list item exists.

confidence_assignment.high: Directly supported by an Issue, reproducer, official developer response, benchmark metadata, PR, or linked fix.
confidence_assignment.medium: Strongly supported by multiple evidence items, but not explicitly confirmed.
confidence_assignment.low: Unknown, incomplete, weakly supported, or analyst-inferred without sufficient corroboration.

value_selection_rules.conservative_default: When evidence is insufficient, use null for free text, unknown for controlled enums, an empty array for lists, and low for confidence.

field_constraints.canonical_name: A concise mechanism-oriented lower_snake_case name. Do not include Issue IDs, commit IDs, crash signals, scripts, or arbitrary constants.
field_constraints.supporting_reports: Must contain exactly one direct_evidence item whose report_id is the input Report ID.
field_constraints.evidence_refs: Every non-empty evidence_refs array must contain only identifiers supplied in available_evidence_refs.
field_constraints.primary_defect_class: Select exactly one defect class for every emitted Pattern.
field_constraints.secondary_defect_classes: Use only directly relevant additional defect classes. It may be empty.
field_constraints.risk_dimensions: Use evidence-supported dimensions that locate the triggering risk. It may be an empty array when no concrete risk dimension can be determined.
field_constraints.trigger_conditions: Represent historical trigger facts, not proposed input-generation steps.
field_constraints.operation_context: Use null when no call sequence or execution context is known.
field_constraints.historical_oracle: Use null when the historical Report does not contain an observable oracle.

template_interpretation.required_array_rule: Populate an array only with evidence-supported items. Do not copy null placeholder objects into the final response.
template_interpretation.default_value_rule: Replace unknown, null, and low defaults whenever the input Report provides sufficient evidence for a more specific value.
